security_cases: normal use performs no third-party content transmission
user-controlled text renders via textContent or explicit escaping
file parsers and decoders have byte/dimension/count bounds
generated HTML/PDF/export strings do not inject raw user markup
camera/screen access occurs only after explicit user gesture
responsive_accessibility_cases: 320px viewport has no page-level horizontal scroll
result region uses role=status and aria-live=polite
canvas/media tools provide textual metrics and controls
performance_cases: large media operations are user-triggered and bounded
object URLs are revoked when replaced or downloaded
no normal calculation requires a Cloudflare Worker
